results.content: Deno 2.9 is here, headlined by deno desktop, a new way to build native desktop applications from the web stack you already know, with no Electron boilerplate and a single binary at the end. `deno desktop` for building native desktop apps from web tech, first-class migration from npm/pnpm/yarn/Bun, CSS module imports, snapshot and parameterized testing, smaller `deno compile --bundle` binaries, and Node.js 26 compatibility.
